program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((markers (find-color g 9))
         (non9 (remove-color g 9 0))
         (template (crop-to-content non9))
         (bb (bbox-of-cells (filter-cells non9 (lambda (r c v) (not (= v 0))))))
         (positions (cons (list (first bb) (second bb)) markers)))
    (for*/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
               ([pos (in-list positions)]
                [r (in-range (rows template))]
                [c (in-range (cols template))])
      (let ((v (at template r c))
            (rr (+ (first pos) r))
            (cc (+ (second pos) c)))
        (if (and (not (= v 0)) (in-bounds? rr cc (rows g) (cols g)))
            (set-cell out rr cc v)
            out)))))
